```sql
SELECT s.CharterNum, AVG(f.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgWritingScore
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode AND s.CharterNum = f.Charter_School_Number
WHERE f.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.CharterNum
ORDER BY AvgWritingScore DESC;
```
